Post 1

📈 ASX 200 hit a 20-day high Thursday, closing at 8,891.80 (+44.50pts, +0.50%). Financials and REITs carried the index while consumer stocks sold off hard. Still 4.36% from the 52-week high — the ceiling is in sight. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🏦 Financials +1.86% and A-REITs +1.84% led Thursday's session. Consumer Discretionary -1.98% and Consumer Staples -1.77% were the drag. Rate-sensitive sectors winning, spending-sensitive sectors losing — the market is pricing something in. #ASX #banking #property

Post 3

MSB surged 23.40% to AUD 2.32 — the session's standout move by a mile. Mesoblast has a habit of violent re-ratings on clinical news. When biotech runs like this on volume, the rest of the healthcare tape tends to notice. #ASX #biotech #healthcare

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,728.29/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7046. A softer Aussie dollar amplifies gold returns for local holders — that tailwind is real and it's showing up in the price. Silver at AUD 74.90/oz. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

ASX sits 4.36% off its 52-week high. The question for Friday: can Financials hold their gains and close that gap, or does Consumer weakness spread? Watch the 8,900 level. Where do you see the index by end of week? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
